title: HELIX Bridge: Workday Student → Enrollment
description: Maps Workday Student course registration objects to the HELIX Enrollment resource.

source_objects.description: A student's registration in a course section. Contains status, dates, grading basis.
Final grade record for a completed registration.
A specific offering of a course in an academic period. Used for section reference resolution.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Resolve the Student reference WID to HELIX Student.helix_id
Resolve the Course_Section reference WID to HELIX CourseSection.helix_id
Resolve the Academic_Period reference WID to HELIX AcademicPeriod.helix_id

Map Workday registration status to HELIX: 'Registered'→'registered', 'Enrolled'→'enrolled', 'Waitlisted'→'waitlisted', 'Dropped'→'dropped', 'Withdrawn'→'withdrawn'. If Student_Course_Grade exists with final grade → 'completed'.
attribute_mappings.notes: Workday distinguishes 'Registered' (before term start) from 'Enrolled' (confirmed after census). The exact status values are tenant-configurable.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Cast to ISO 8601 date. Null if not dropped.
Direct map. Workday uses 'Credit Units' terminology.
Direct map from grade record. Null if course not yet completed.
Direct map. The official final grade reference ID. Null if in progress.

attribute_mappings.source: Student_Course_Grade.Quality_Points or calculated from Grade × Credit_Units
attribute_mappings.transformation: Direct map or calculate. Depends on institutional Workday configuration.
Map Workday grading basis to HELIX: 'Letter_Grade'→'standard', 'Pass_Fail'→'pass_fail', 'Audit'→'audit', 'Satisfactory_Unsatisfactory'→'satisfactory_unsatisfactory'.
attribute_mappings.notes: Grading basis reference IDs are configurable per tenant.
